3f1c6a02-8b47-4d19-9a52-0e7c4b8d1a63.name: Hyatt Proposal Workflow
3f1c6a02-8b47-4d19-9a52-0e7c4b8d1a63.description: Chat-triggered Hyatt ABM workflow: plan + research the account (Hyatt Proposal Planner, which runs the web research itself with search_web/browse_web and writes a citation-backed brief to a canvas) -> build and publish one HyattProposal page (Hyatt Proposal Builder). Say e.g. "Build a Hyatt proposal for Optimizely covering Camp Opticon in New York and London". Single page type, so there is no persona loop. This repo has no generic web_research agent by design - the research step is the platform's built-in search_web / browse_web / figure_out_search_keywords tools invoked directly by the planner.

steps.name: Hyatt Proposal Planner
steps.description: Parses the plain-language request into the account, the event/travel calendar to target, and the lead commercial pillar; then runs the account research itself with figure_out_search_keywords / search_web / browse_web, writes a citation-backed brief to a canvas (CANVAS_ID trailer), and emits a one-page JSON page plan.

steps.name: Hyatt Proposal Builder
steps.description: Reads the research brief from the planner's canvas (research_canvas_id) and creates + publishes ONE HyattProposal page in the Optimizely CMS. Hyatt-side facts come from the hyatt-vendor-facts skill. Requires container_key to be set in the Opal UI.

triggers.name: Chat
triggers.description: Trigger when user sends a message
